bands.name: Good
bands.advice: Clean air. Nothing to plan around.

bands.name: Satisfactory
bands.advice: Fine for almost everyone. People who are unusually sensitive may notice slight discomfort.

bands.name: Moderate
bands.advice: People with asthma, heart or lung conditions, children and older adults may feel it. Go easier on long outdoor exercise.

bands.name: Poor
bands.advice: Most people may feel some discomfort over long exposure. Sensitive groups should cut down time outdoors.

bands.name: Very Poor
bands.advice: Long exposure can bring on breathing trouble. Skip outdoor exercise and keep windows shut at the worst hours.

bands.name: Severe
bands.advice: Affects healthy people too. Stay indoors where you can; sensitive groups should not go out.
